notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
I worked a lot to make cards feel real but stay minimalist. Also optimize and add some details.

Improved animations and sounds. 

Added new scene animation after chapter complete, if you want see it again just solve last level in solved chapter!

notes.title: Demo Update #001 - Undos
notes.notes:
I added undo, so now when you get confused you can always go back a step.

Also many minor fixes and optimisations, hope it works now even better)

Thanks to Gabriel for requesting this feature and everyone who give me feedback, I appreciate it.

Consider a wishlist and share game with friends!
